failure_modes.description: The agent inspects repository status and history to identify target states or branches, but terminates the episode and sets completion to true before executing the necessary integration or modification commands.
failure_modes.needed_instead: The agent must execute the required modification and integration steps after identifying the target state before declaring completion.

success_habits.description: Systematically inspecting version control logs and branch histories to locate lost state or target references before performing integration.
success_habits.risk_if_broken: The agent would lack necessary awareness of repository branch structures and commit histories to know what state needs to be integrated.
